name: Document: Write the working-with-me spine's additions and the protection order's frame as the instrument's revision text
text_content:
I4, I11, section 9.4. The additions to prompts A (the seat description's outward half pointed to and the seams found since), B (the knowledge-transfer register and its dates), C (presence by period and week in a field's form, the languages held, closed-hour availability, the consequences of commitments outside the house in general terms), D (the founder's draft of the interim rule and Class B preference), E (how a range breach written as a question is to be said), F (the dependency column into the ledger), H (the load line's signals expected first), I (the post-service rule and the live-risk state written not called), J (the pairing's dependencies), and K (the learning agenda dated and revisited at every reset), each printed beside the prompt's four-part guidance as a record to feed or a rule to answer and never as content; and the protection order's four tiers as a private appendix with only the second tier's dates leaving the document. Owned by the partners; the packaging stays gated on 86ajgn2z5 under 86akh2r2x. Extends 86akh2r2x and 86akh3x9m by reference. Normal.

Filed by Session 16 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmjz6. Reasoning lives on the S16 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
